paragraphs: I am a final-year Computer Science Engineering student based in Bengaluru, specializing in Java Full Stack development, enterprise backend engineering, and modern web applications. My core strength lies in translating complex business logic into scalable, maintainable software with a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Data Structures & Algorithms, and relational database architecture.

On the backend, I engineer secure, high-throughput RESTful services using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, and MySQL/SQLite—implementing clean API contracts, JWT authentication, and query optimization. On the frontend, I build fluid, mobile-first user interfaces using React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and rapid page load speeds.

Through my virtual internship at Infosys Springboard, I designed an automated Python AST static analysis and LLM extraction pipeline that cut manual documentation overhead by 70%. Earlier at Innobyte Services, I restructured commercial client interfaces to boost UI/UX performance metrics by 80%. I am driven to deliver production-ready software as a Software Development Engineer (SDE) or Associate Software Engineer (ASE).
